company.name: Lifemost
company.shortDescription: Lifemost is a AI-driven corporate well-being platform.
company.description: Lifemost is a corporate well-being platform for physical and mental health, providing tech solutions for enterprises. Lifemost combines hybrid well-being benefits, including offline and online activities for fitness, mindfulness, and active recovery, as well as live sessions with psychologists and health coaches. The core Lifemost innovation is an anAI-powered assistant that is designed to deliver data-driven well-being programs throughout organizations by reducing barriers in personalization and engagement

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $650,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,747,080 to $6,747,080, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 25 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 48 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
